need: A repository made from the template keeps running its commit checks after its folder is moved and in every git worktree.

searched.found: aes hooks install already writes a tracked .githooks/pre-commit and sets core.hooksPath; the template used an absolute path instead.

searched.where: lefthook documentation (lefthook install, custom hooksPath); git-config core.hooksPath
searched.found: git resolves a relative core.hooksPath from the working tree root; a tracked hooks folder is a common pattern (.githooks).

candidates.name: lefthook install --force into a relative .githooks
candidates.covers: Writes the hook scripts lefthook expects.
candidates.misses: Its scripts carry the installing machine's lefthook path, so they cannot be tracked in a portable template.
candidates.reason: Tracked scripts must not name a machine path; untracked ones are missing in new worktrees.

candidates.name: Tracked one-line .githooks scripts calling lefthook run
candidates.covers: Same pattern aes hooks install uses; works in moved copies and worktrees (tried by hand 2026-11-22).
candidates.reason: Smallest change; two three-line files and one config value.

gap: None; the existing tracked-hooks pattern is applied to the template.
